decisions.summary: Initialize collapsedSections from draft.section_order so all sections start minimized
Added formatUrl() to prepend https:// to LinkedIn/Website on blur
Removed Job Imports and Applications nav links (routes/pages left intact)
Replaced unicode/emoji feature icons with Heroicons to match project icon convention
Marked decorative feature icons aria-hidden; removed fake-clickable styling from dead Privacy/Terms/Contact footer text

Established token spine: neutral+accent ramps, motion primitives, semantic surface/text/border/accent/status layer with light+dark remaps, wired into Tailwind config as rgb(var(...)/<alpha-value>) utilities
Fixed both finalize Critical findings: focus-visible on Forgot-password link, renamed overlay-sounding class to surface-card to clear modal-pattern detector false positive
Polish pass on auth surface: visual (not color-only) confirmation feedback, active/pressed states on buttons and toggles, on-brand checkbox color via token spine

Migrated 5 utility auth pages from raw-hex GuestLayout to new token-driven AuthCenteredLayout (recipe-auth.md centered-card composition); fixed focus-visible and off-token colors along the way; kept GuestLayout.tsx since Onboarding/Wizard.tsx still depends on it
Shared button a11y: focus-visible rings, semantic tokens, Modal transition-all removed
Workstation header/toolbar MenuItems and toggles get focus-visible rings
Destructive delete/remove actions require window.confirm via onConfirm pattern

Batch swap non-modal bg-surface-overlay to bg-surface-card
Admin restore uses shared Headless UI Modal; table overflow-x-auto
Pair remaining outline-none with focus-visible rings across app
Fix width animation via scaleX; clear all detector majors (focus-visible, eyebrows, empty states, tables, em-dashes)

Token spine: radii/z/shadow/ramps; brand freeze migration; accent-text fix
